subject: microbiology
title: Serratia marcescens, Urinary Tract Infection Microbiology and Citrobacter

steps.tx: **Serratia marcescens** is the red pigmenting (prodigiosin) enteric of hospital water, sinks, soaps and respiratory equipment: motile, DNase and gelatinase positive, lactose late or non fermenter, AmpC and intrinsic colistin resistance, causing urinary, line, ventilator and eye infections in clusters that trace to moist reservoirs.
steps.say: Pink pigment in a sink and Serratia in the unit's blood cultures share an address.

left.title: Serratia identity
points: Prodigiosin red at room temperature (many clinical strains unpigmented)
Lives in disinfectant residues and soap films

right.title: Serratia outbreaks
points: Contaminated antiseptics and hand creams historically
Environmental sampling of sinks and solutions

steps.tx: **Urinary tract infection microbiology** deserves its bench rules: clean catch midstream, colony counts interpreted by method (10^5 classic, lower symptomatic thresholds in women, suprapubic any growth), mixed growth contamination logic, cultures before antibiotics in complicated, pregnancy, male, recurrent and catheter change contexts.
steps.say: Count colonies by how the urine was collected, not by one threshold for all.

left.title: Collection grammar
points: Catheter specimen from port, not bag
Bag urine in infants: negative only useful

right.title: Count grammar
points: Mixed three plus organisms: contamination likely
Pure growth with pyuria weighs more

steps.tx: **Urine culture media** (CLED stopping Proteus swarm while supporting all uropathogens, chromogenic agars colouring E coli and Proteus directly, blood and MacConkey pairs) plus dipstick leukocyte esterase and nitrite (Enterobacterales reduce nitrate, enterococcus and staphylococcus do not reliably) triage before colonies.
steps.say: Nitrite negative does not clear enterococcus; dipsticks read chemistry, not species.

left.title: Dipstick logic
points: Nitrite: dietary nitrate reducers (most gram negatives)
Both negative: UTI unlikely in many adults

right.title: Culture logic
points: Incubation 18 to 24 hours, longer for fastidious requests

steps.tx: **Citrobacter** (freundii AmpC hospital, koseri neonatal meningitis and brain abscess notorious) ferments lactose variably, uses citrate (its name), H2S inconstantly mimicking Salmonella, speciation mattering because koseri's neonatal brain tropism changes imaging in meningitis.
steps.say: Citrobacter koseri in a neonatal meningitis earns a brain abscess scan.

steps.tx: **Asymptomatic bacteriuria** rules protect patients from urine culture enthusiasm: treat only pregnancy and before invasive urological procedures, not elderly, diabetic or catheterised patients, because treatment selects resistance without benefit and positive cultures in delirium mislead source hunting.
steps.say: Cloudy urine in an elderly catheter is not a prescription; treat patients, not colonies.

left.title: Treat bacteriuria
points: Neutropenic and transplant nuances by guideline

right.title: Do not treat
points: Delirium alone without urinary signs or systemic source

steps.tx: **Complicated UTI organisms beyond E coli** (Proteus stones, Klebsiella, Pseudomonas catheters, enterococcus, Staphylococcus saprophyticus young women, aureus haematogenous warning) each redirect imaging and therapy; recurrent same species suggests stones or obstruction, new species suggests reinfection.
steps.say: Relapse means a stone or obstruction hides the same organism; reinfection means a new one arrived.

steps.tx: **Serratia resistance pattern** (inducible AmpC, intrinsic colistin and nitrofurantoin resistance, carbapenemase acquisitions reported) and environmental persistence combine into unit level threat, outbreak responses sampling soaps, sinks, and respiratory fluids while restricting implicated products.
steps.say: When Serratia clusters, culture the soap before blaming the staff.

right.title: Outbreak method
points: Line list by time place device

steps.tx: **Edwardsiella, Hafnia and lesser enterics** finish the family tour (Edwardsiella tarda wound and gastroenteritis with aquatic exposure, Hafnia alvei opportunist), MALDI naming what panels once lumped, clinical weight by sterile site and host as always.
steps.say: Rare enterics earn respect by address: sterile site plus sick host.

left.title: Lesser genera
points: Edwardsiella tarda: water wounds, bacteraemia in liver disease
